subject.title: fix(tools): unescape literal newline sequences in write tool content (#114292) [AI-assisted]

question: Should OpenClaw treat literal backslash-n in the write tool’s already-parsed `content` argument as a universal newline escape, or preserve it and repair only a source-specific malformed tool-call encoding path?
rationale: After content reaches this write boundary, the string alone cannot distinguish a model’s accidental double-escaping from an intentional request to write literal backslash-n text.

options.title: Repair the source-specific encoding path
options.body: Preserve the write-tool content contract and normalize only where malformed provider or tool-call transport data can be identified.

options.title: Adopt universal write-tool unescaping
options.body: Accept that literal backslash-n content will be rewritten and document this as a deliberate incompatible content contract.

recommendation.title: Repair the source-specific encoding path
recommendation.body: Preserve the write-tool content contract and normalize only where malformed provider or tool-call transport data can be identified.
